sources.title: lazarenkod/gemma4-e2b-fluent-books · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A LoRA fine-tune of google/gemma-4-E2B-it with its vocabulary cut from 262,144 to 40,000 tokens, merged and quantised (Q4_K_M, the per-layer embedding table at Q3_K, with an importance matrix), for the on-device assistant of the Fluent Books reading app (an English reader for Russian speakers).
